items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: Santy Runion was one of them and another one was named Junie Ferrell. And they were very good teachers, I didn’t pick them, my parents picked them for me because they knew that I could learn something from them and indeed I did.

ctx.x: Stan Kenton’s band musically was quite different, wasn’t it?

Oh yeah. Well actually a lot of both bands’ music were less than what I was used to because with the people that I grew up with were members of the same band — we would all be writing charts for the band and learning from each other and most of the people who were on Woody’s band or Stan’s band didn’t have that kind of a background. They were sort of winging it, and succeeding, but I was considered to be kind of an over- intellectualized musician if you want to think of it that way. But they appreciated me, they…
Did you get tired of life on the road riding on a bus etcetera?
